Hotel.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initialize a hotel-like instance by storing the provided name, storing the provided room-availability mapping as-is, and creating an empty booking record." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> name </REF>: any "Value assigned directly to the instance name attribute without validation or transformation."
        <REF> rooms </REF>: any "Value assigned directly to the instance available_rooms attribute; comments indicate it is expected to be a mapping from room types to available counts, such as {'single': 5, 'double': 3}, but no validation is performed."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the input value name directly to the instance attribute self.name without modification or validation. RESULT self.name]
            [COMMAND Assign the input value rooms directly to the instance attribute self.available_rooms without modification, validation, or copying; preserve the provided value as-is, including empty, zero-count, None, or malformed states. RESULT self.available_rooms]
            [COMMAND Initialize the instance attribute self.booked_rooms to a new empty dictionary to represent no booked rooms at creation time. RESULT self.booked_rooms]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Hotel.book_room:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Checks whether a requested room type and quantity can be booked, records the booking when fully available, and otherwise returns either remaining availability or False." book_room]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> room_type </REF>: data_type "The room category being requested."
        <REF> room_number </REF>: data_type "The number of rooms requested for booking."
        <REF> name </REF>: data_type "The booking identifier used as the key under the selected room type."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: mixed "Returns 'Success!' when the booking is completed, returns the remaining available count when the request exceeds current availability but availability is not zero, and returns False when the room type does not exist or no rooms remain."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether room_type is absent from self.available_rooms keys; if it is absent, return False immediately. RESULT availability_type_check]
            [COMMAND If room_number is less than or equal to self.available_rooms[room_type], enter the successful booking path with the inclusive boundary preserved for exact availability matches. RESULT enough_rooms_condition]
            [COMMAND Within the successful booking path, check whether room_type is absent from self.booked_rooms keys; if it is absent, initialize self.booked_rooms[room_type] as an empty dictionary. RESULT booked_room_type_ready]
            [COMMAND Within the successful booking path, store the booking by setting self.booked_rooms[room_type][name] to room_number. RESULT booking_recorded]
            [COMMAND Within the successful booking path, decrease self.available_rooms[room_type] by room_number. RESULT availability_updated]
            [COMMAND Within the successful booking path, return "Success!" immediately. RESULT success_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: room_number is greater than self.available_rooms[room_type] and self.available_rooms[room_type] is not equal to 0.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return self.available_rooms[room_type] without modifying booked_rooms or available_rooms. RESULT partial_availability_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: room_number is greater than self.available_rooms[room_type] and self.available_rooms[room_type] is equal to 0.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False without modifying state. RESULT no_availability_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Hotel.check_in:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Validates a check-in request against booked rooms for a room type and either rejects invalid quantities, removes a fully checked-in booking, or decreases a partially checked-in booking count." check_in]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> room_type </REF>: any "The room category whose booking records are checked."
        <REF> room_number </REF>: any "The number of rooms to check in against the existing booking for the guest."
        <REF> name </REF>: any "The guest name used as the booking key within the selected room type."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean_or_none "Returns False when the room type does not exist in booked rooms or when the requested check-in quantity exceeds the booked quantity; otherwise performs in-place updates and returns no explicit value."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether room_type is absent from self.booked_rooms.keys(). RESULT room_type_missing]
            [COMMAND If room_type_missing is true, return False immediately. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Check whether name exists in self.booked_rooms[room_type]. RESULT name_booked_for_room_type]
            [COMMAND If name_booked_for_room_type is true, compare room_number to self.booked_rooms[room_type][name]. RESULT requested_vs_booked_comparison]
            [COMMAND Within the branch where name_booked_for_room_type is true, if room_number is strictly greater than self.booked_rooms[room_type][name], return False immediately without modifying state. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Within the branch where name_booked_for_room_type is true, else if room_number is exactly equal to self.booked_rooms[room_type][name], remove name from self.booked_rooms[room_type] using pop. RESULT booking_removed]
            [COMMAND Within the branch where name_booked_for_room_type is true, otherwise decrease self.booked_rooms[room_type][name] by room_number. RESULT booking_count_reduced]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: name does not exist in self.booked_rooms[room_type] after confirming that room_type exists.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Perform no booking update and allow the method to finish without an explicit return value. RESULT no_action]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Hotel.check_out:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Updates the available room count for a room type by adding to an existing entry or creating a new entry with the provided room number." check_out]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> room_type </REF>: any "The room type key to look up and update in available_rooms."
        <REF> room_number </REF>: any "The quantity to add to the existing room type count or assign as the initial count."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether room_type exists as a key in self.available_rooms. RESULT room_type_exists]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: room_type exists in self.available_rooms]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Add room_number to the current value stored at self.available_rooms[room_type]. RESULT self.available_rooms[room_type]]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: room_type does not exist in self.available_rooms]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create self.available_rooms[room_type] and set its value to room_number. RESULT self.available_rooms[room_type]]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Hotel.get_available_rooms:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the value stored in the instance's available_rooms container at the position or key specified by room_type." get_available_rooms]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> room_type </REF>: selector "The key or index used to access an entry in self.available_rooms."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: any "The value retrieved directly from self.available_rooms using room_type as the key or index."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the instance attribute self.available_rooms and use room_type as the key or index to retrieve the corresponding stored value. RESULT selected_room_value]
            [COMMAND Return the retrieved value unchanged. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
